name: interleukin 7 receptor

function.text: IL7R encodes interleukin-7 receptor subunit alpha. Annotated molecular activities include cytokine receptor activity and interleukin-7 receptor activity. It participates in signal transduction and hemopoiesis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to immunodeficiency 104 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
